mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% (UNRATE > 4.5%) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically triggers a market expectation of central bank rate cuts, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1500) and retail sales (RSAFS < 700000) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate policy stimulus.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 320), the market prices in an expectation of aggressive monetary tightening, which initially depresses equity valuations but leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates a soft landing.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 320.

mechanism_narrative: A high industrial production index (INDPRO > 103.0) signals robust manufacturing activity, which typically boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 103.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1400 (HOUST < 1400) signals a weakening in the housing market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate central bank intervention to support the economy.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 1400.

mechanism_narrative: In high housing demand regimes (HOUST > 1500), the market prices in strong consumer spending, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1500.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market adjusts to the new policy stance and anticipates stable growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.
